verdict.rationale: Claude has a developer API, so an interactive API reference with runnable examples is a fair question to ask of it. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents an interactive reference, API explorer, or runnable examples. The Console is mentioned only for managing keys, usage, and billing, and probes found no OpenAPI spec at any candidate path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
